shared_elements: horizontal register band of repeated arch/loop motifs (H-like or arched forms) along the top
band of short vertical strokes / fringe or zigzag line dividing registers
quadruped animals in profile below the band
low-relief carving on a flat stone face
register-based composition with stacked horizontal zones
justification: Both surfaces show the identical scheme: an upper register of repeated arched/loop symbols, separated by a band of short vertical strokes (fringe/zigzag), above a lower register of profile quadrupeds in low relief with the same schematic outline-and-flat-relief convention. B extends further, adding lower-shaft imagery (bird-like figures, plant/branch motif) not visible on A, and A's animals are more uniformly aligned, but the shared register scheme and motif vocabulary are highly specific.
